notes.title: I just reached a huge production milestone!
notes.content:
I am very happy to inform you that, as of last week, the "silent movie" version of the last chapter of Meduziak is finally finished! What this basically means is that every possible player interaction is now programmed and tested. In other words: THE GAME IS NOW FULLY PLAYABLE FROM START TO FINISH and this fully playable verstion will see the light of day pretty soon! Awesome!

Currently I'm working on the very last cutscene, which should be finished next week. There is basically zero creative work after this point. There's still some work on assets (graphics, sound effects and music), but... the "to do list" will only get shorter and shorter every day, and it is only a matter of time before Meduziak is completed!

Will I be able to finish and publish the next early access chapter in June (as I wrote in my last devlogs)? Sadly, I don't think I will. There's simply too much to do still. I'll do my best to publish the next chapter in July. Fingers crossed!

Have a great weekend!
Adam / Fieldfare Studios

notes.title: End of March development information.
notes.content:
A quick information package from the production front: I'm still working on the "silent movie" version of the last chapter of the game, and... it's actually going pretty good! This week I've FINALLY started working on the VERY LAST LOCATION of the game! Give it a couple of weeks and it'll be finished as well!

Now, now - calm down Adam - let's not get overly enthisiastic just yet. There's still much work to do after the "silent movie" phase (sound effects, music, improved graphical assets and custcenes). Yeah... that's obviously true, but finishing this production step will be a HUGE milestone, and... I can already feel it coming!

In my last devlog, I've witten that the complete early access version should be ready "around May / June". At this pace, this is still within the realm of possibility. 

Thanks for all the support!
Adam / Fieldfare Studios

notes.title: Christmas wishes and some progress information.
notes.content:
First of all, I would like to take a moment to wish all of you a very calm and lazy Christmas season, with plenty of great food and rest. I hope you'll be able to find some time to decompress before 2025 takes off. 

Now, a quick production update. The last chapter of the game is more than 40% done (I am currently working on the third location out of six). I had to slow down for a bit in November due to some intensive work obligations, but I'm fully back on track now. At this rate, it seems that the game will finally be finished in the next few months, with complete early access version ready around May / June. After this, I am planning to give it some time, fix a couple of bugs, and improve a thing or two, before the official game premiere in the fall.

Thank you for being patient and supportive! Production takes a lot of time and effort, and it wouldn't be possible without your interest in the game.

Have a wonderful 2025! 
Adam / Fieldfare Studios

notes.title: It's official: I'm working on the final chapter of Meduziak!
notes.content:
I am very happy to inform you guys that I've already started working on the last chapter of the game! 

I've finally "reached the critical mass" of the planning phase. The project file (listing all the interactions, items, characters etc.) is not yet complete, BUT... I'm almost there (it only has a couple of smaller "blanks" to fill). It is, in fact, advanced enough to allow me to start drawing the level designs!

I've attached the first one of them here - hope you'll like it! I'll post more sketches in about 2-3 weeks.

Enjoy the rest of the summer!
Adam / Fieldfare Studios

notes.title: The price of Meduziak is now localized!
notes.content:
[b]Hi![/b]

I just want to inform you all that in the recent days, I took a closer look at the pricing of my game around the world. While the planned price (11-12 USD) is pretty reasonable for a game of this scope, there are lots of countries where it is a lot of money, and I don't see a single reason why my small indie game should be a considerable part of someone's home budget.

It took some effort, but I finally decided on a method of doing this, and... I just lowered the price of my game in about half of the currencies proposed by Steam (by different percentages, depending on economical situation of the country / region). No country has been affected negatively by these changes (I didn't raise the price anywhere - it is either the automated price converted by Steam, or lower).

This is NOT a short-term discount. I intend for the prices to remain localized.

Have fun!
Adam / Fieldfare Studios

notes.title: Merry Christmas! New chapter of Meduziak's adventures is almost complete!
notes.content:
This is my first devlog here, so... first of all... 

[b]Merry Christmas![/b]

I just wanted to give you guys a quick update on the progress on my goofy adventure game Meduziak. Production is going strong! The next chapter of the game is almost complete, and will be coming soon (the early access version should be updated in about a month).

The current state of the new chapter is as follows:
- the episode is fully playable from start to finish,
- all sound effects are implemented,
- music theme is close to completion,
- all animations are ready,
- most of the graphical assets are finished,
- minigames are completed,
- save/load system is working and is compatible with previous save states.

In other words... we are "almost there"! I've attached a few screenshots if you are curious (don't worry - there are no spoilers there). 

See you soon!
Adam / Fieldfare Studios
